answer: Underwriter syndicates keep farms from treating the ledger as a haven for cheap clones. First, every join must recruit a VRF-picked syndicate of four established agents locking 50 POA each for 24 epochs. Second, no agent may underwrite more than two open syndicates. Third, two failed grades or a correlation flag burns half of every lock. Fourth, early emissions skim a 15% premium into that pool. Minting 100 sybils means bribing 200 strangers to risk 10,000 POA on a frozen tundra of capital — like four random neighbors co-signing a mortgage tied by one red thread of shared loss.
